name: Button
description: Actions with consistent hierarchy, sizing, loading, and accessible icon treatment.

anatomy.description: The visible text naming the action; required unless the button is icon-only.
An optional leading or trailing glyph that supports the label, hidden from assistive technology.
Replaces the content while loading and keeps the button disabled until the action settles.
The icon-only variant; its label prop becomes the aria-label and the tooltip text.

dos: Use one primary button per view so the main action is unambiguous.
Write verb-led labels that say what happens, like "Save changes".
Use IconButton with a descriptive label for icon-only actions.
donts: Don't use a button for navigation; use a Link instead.
Don't rely on the danger color alone; keep the destructive label explicit.
Don't disable a button without explaining why nearby.

examples.title: Variants and sizes
examples.description: Primary, secondary, ghost, and danger variants with a dedicated IconButton for icon-only actions.

examples.title: Disabled actions
examples.description: Use disabled state when the action cannot be completed yet, and explain why nearby.

guidance.useWhen: A user needs to take an explicit action.
guidance.avoidWhen: The control is only communicating status or navigation.
guidance.behavior: Loading disables the native button until the action completes.
guidance.responsive: Let actions wrap in narrow toolbars instead of shrinking their labels.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the button.

notes: Icon-only actions use IconButton, which requires a label applied as aria-label and mirrored in the title tooltip.
Loading buttons set aria-busy and are disabled so they cannot be activated twice.
A loading IconButton replaces its icon with a spinner while keeping the accessible label.
The danger variant carries meaning through its label as well as its color.

props.description: Accessible label applied as `aria-label`; also used as the default tooltip text.
props.name: label

props.description: Replaces the icon with a spinner and disables the button while true.
props.name: loading
